# jcode v1.0.2

**Xinchuang (信创) ARM64 portability release.** The Linux ARM64 asset is now built against the glibc 2.17 baseline in the manylinux2014_aarch64 container (emulated-TLS Termux contract kept), so the same binary runs on Xinchuang machines with glibc 2.23/2.28, newer distros, and Termux. Includes the upstream master sync through 2026-11-18.

Download: <https://github.com/kolehank/jcode/releases/tag/v1.0.2>
